title: CodeAxis Blueprint
description: The canonical blueprint JSON (build-plan.md Part 6, Part 4.G; Part 13 decision #4). A typed, versioned design for work on one snapshot of one repository - never a raw diagram. The database tables in supabase/migrations/20261021000000_blueprint.sql are the source of truth; this is the shape they assemble into for the API, the React Flow view and exports. Deliberately a separate vocabulary from the Repo Model's node/edge kinds: those describe code that exists, this describes a design for code that does not.

schema_version.description: An unknown value is rejected at read time, never coerced into the shape the reader expects.

commit_sha.description: The snapshot the design was grounded against. Every claim in this document is about this commit and no other.

task_id.description: Required: a blueprint hangs off exactly one Context Engine task, so requirements and constraints are referenced from Pillar 2 rather than duplicated here.

status.description: invalid is a first-class resting state, not an error to swallow: Part 4.G.5 requires an invalid blueprint to be rejected with its reasons attached.

components.description: The capabilities in the design. `key` is the stable identity across versions; connections and proposed files reference components by key, never by id, so a partial regeneration can leave untouched parts alone (Part 4.G.9).

data_flows.description: Derived at read time from `connections` where kind == 'data_flow'. Present for readers that want it named, but it is a view, not a second stored collection - a data flow can never drift from the connection it describes.

modules.description: A lightweight grouping of components by their `module_key`. A module has no identity beyond the components in it, which is why it is not a table.

layout.description: Positions only, keyed by component/connection `key`. Stored apart from semantics (Part 4.G.6) so arranging the diagram neither creates a new version of the design nor breaks when the rows it positions are regenerated.

requirement_ids.description: References into codeaxis.requirements. Referenced, never copied: duplicating a requirement here would give the design its own divergent idea of what was asked for.

constraint_ids.description: References into codeaxis.constraints, the Constraint Ledger.

unresolved.description: Open decisions and gaps carried into the document rather than guessed away (Part 4.G.5, Part 0.3). An empty array means nothing was open, not that nothing was checked.

affects.description: Component keys this open question blocks, when it blocks specific ones.

kind.description: What this is relative to the repo as it stands.

mapping.description: What the design does to it. Paired with `kind`, never independent: existing+reuse, modified+extend, proposed+new. Any other combination is a contradiction and is refused by the database, the Pydantic model and the validator alike.

linked_component_id.description: The codeaxis.nodes id (a cluster-kind node) this maps to. Required for `existing` and `modified` - Part 11's 'existing components map to real entities' - and null for `proposed`, which by definition maps to nothing yet.

responsibility.description: What this component is for, in one or two sentences. Untrusted text: model-authored prose, never instructions.

generation_status.description: Replaces the Repo Model's origin tag for blueprint rows: none of parsed/configured/inferred honestly describes an authored design, and `locked` is a state regeneration must refuse to overwrite (Part 4.G.9).

locked.description: A human approved this; a regeneration that would change it is rejected rather than silently applied. One fact with generation_status == 'locked', not two.

kind.description: dependency is the only kind a cycle is invalid in; control flow, data flow and events legitimately loop (retries, polling, pub/sub).

source_key.description: A component `key` in this same version. The validator rejects a dangling endpoint; Postgres cannot express this as a foreign key.

data_shape.description: Only meaningful on a data_flow; must be null on any other kind.

status.description: new must not collide with a path that already exists in the snapshot; modified and unchanged must correspond to one that does (Part 4.G.5).

conventions_refs.description: codeaxis.conventions ids that justified this path and shape (Part 4.G.7). An empty array is shown as an uncited placement rather than hidden.

contextEvidence.description: Reused unchanged from the Agent Context Engine (Part 5), so the citation validator that already checks chat answers and context items checks these spans too.

truncated.description: True when inputs had to be capped to fit a budget - an admitted gap, not a silent one.
